user.title: Connect to your BUSY Bar
user.description: Enter the address of the bar on your network. If you have restricted its HTTP API to key access, enter that access key (or an API token) as well.

data_description.host: The bar's IP address or hostname.
data_description.token: Leave empty if the bar's Wi-Fi API access is set to open, or if you reach it over USB.
data_description.port: Leave at {default_port} unless you reach the bar through a proxy.

discovery_confirm.title: Add {name}
discovery_confirm.description: A BUSY Bar was found at {host}. It needs an access key or API token before Home Assistant can talk to it.

data_description.token: Set this on the bar under Settings, API access.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate your BUSY Bar
reauth_confirm.description: The bar at {host} rejected the stored access key. Enter the current key or a fresh API token.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the bar at that address.
error.invalid_auth: The bar rejected that access key or token.
error.not_busybar: That address answered, but it does not look like a BUSY Bar.

abort.already_configured: This BUSY Bar is already set up.
abort.not_busybar: That device is not a BUSY Bar.
abort.wrong_device: That address belongs to a different BUSY Bar than the one being reconfigured.

data_description.scan_interval: How often to read state from the bar.
data_description.app_name: Every element this integration draws is owned by this name, so clearing the display leaves other apps' elements alone.
data_description.default_priority: Used when a draw service call does not set its own. A running BUSY session holds priority 90, so go above that to draw over one.
data_description.text_font: Font used by the Front message and Back message entities.
data_description.text_color: Colour used by the message entities, as #RRGGBB or #RRGGBBAA.
data_description.text_timeout: How long a message from the message entities stays on screen. Zero keeps it there until it is cleared.

draw_text.name: Draw text
draw_text.description: Draws a line of text on the bar. Characters the bar's bitmap fonts cannot render are folded to their closest ASCII equivalent.

display.name: Display
display.description: Which of the two panels to draw on.

color.name: Colour
color.description: Text colour as #RRGGBB or #RRGGBBAA. Defaults to opaque white.

align.name: Alignment
align.description: Which point of the text is placed at the coordinates.

x.name: X
x.description: Horizontal position of the anchor point. Defaults to the spot the alignment implies.

y.name: Y
y.description: Vertical position of the anchor point. Defaults to the spot the alignment implies.

width.name: Width
width.description: Width of the text box in pixels. Defaults to the panel width when scrolling.

scroll.name: Scroll
scroll.description: Scroll text that is wider than its box. Turn this off for a short label that should sit still.

scroll_rate.name: Scroll rate
scroll_rate.description: Scroll speed in pixels per minute.

scroll_start_delay.name: Scroll start delay
scroll_start_delay.description: Pause before scrolling begins, in milliseconds.

scroll_repeat_delay.name: Scroll repeat delay
scroll_repeat_delay.description: Pause between scroll passes, in milliseconds.

timeout.name: Timeout
timeout.description: Seconds to keep the text on screen. Zero or empty keeps it until cleared.

display_until.name: Display until
display_until.description: Hide the text at this time instead of after a timeout. A datetime or Unix seconds.

z_index.name: Z-index
z_index.description: Higher numbers draw on top of lower ones.

element_id.name: Element ID
element_id.description: Reuse an ID to replace that element; use different IDs to stack several on screen at once.

priority.name: Priority
priority.description: 1 to 100. The bar only accepts a draw whose priority is at least that of the running app: built-in apps are 10, an active BUSY session is 90.

led_color.name: LED colour
led_color.description: Blink the status LED this colour, as #RRGGBB or #RRGGBBAA.

clear_first.name: Clear first
clear_first.description: Remove everything this integration has drawn before drawing this.

draw_countdown.name: Draw countdown
draw_countdown.description: Draws a clock that the bar ticks on its own, so it stays smooth without Home Assistant sending updates.

timestamp.name: Target time
timestamp.description: The moment to count to or from. A datetime or Unix seconds.

direction.name: Direction
direction.description: Whether to count down to the target time or up from it.

show_hours.name: Show hours
show_hours.description: Whether the hours position is always shown.

timeout.name: Timeout
timeout.description: Seconds to keep the clock on screen.

display_until.name: Display until
display_until.description: Hide the clock at this time.

draw_rectangle.name: Draw rectangle
draw_rectangle.description: Draws a box, useful as a progress bar or as a backdrop behind text.

fill_colors.name: Fill colours
fill_colors.description: One colour for a solid fill, two for a gradient.

timeout.name: Timeout
timeout.description: Seconds to keep it on screen.

draw_image.name: Draw image
draw_image.description: Draws an image or animation, either one of the bar's stock assets or a file uploaded to this integration's asset folder.

stock_path.name: Stock path
stock_path.description: Path to a stock asset on the bar, which must start with shared/.

path.name: Asset path
path.description: Path to a file in this integration's own asset folder on the bar.

animation.name: Animation
animation.description: Treat the asset as an animation rather than a still image.

section.name: Section
section.description: Named section of the animation to play.

timeout.name: Timeout
timeout.description: Seconds to keep it on screen.

draw.name: Draw raw elements
draw.description: Sends a list of display elements straight to the bar, for layered scenes and for element types the other services do not wrap.

elements.name: Elements
elements.description: A list of display elements as the bar's HTTP API defines them: text, image, animation, countdown, rectangle or xpmbitmap.

element_ids.name: Element IDs
element_ids.description: Only remove these elements. Leave empty to remove all of them.

everything.name: Everything
everything.description: Also remove elements drawn by other apps and scripts through the bar's draw API.

play_sound.name: Play sound
play_sound.description: Plays a sound file on the bar.

stock_path.name: Stock path
stock_path.description: Path to a stock sound on the bar, which must start with shared/.

path.name: Asset path
path.description: Path to a sound in this integration's own asset folder on the bar.

press_key.name: Press key
press_key.description: Sends a single key press, exactly as pressing the button on the bar would.

start_timer.name: Start session
start_timer.description: Starts a BUSY session from one of the bar's two profile slots.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Run a plain countdown for this long instead of the profile's own timer settings.

stop_timer.name: Stop session
stop_timer.description: Ends the running session and returns the bar to idle.
